''See also: [[Director Porellus Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-01-the-captain|[[Director]] Porellus is an [[Archmage]] and official at the [[Magic Tower]]. He possesses a slug-like physiology, characterized by a large, beige, fleshy body that moves via numerous pseudo-legs and tendrils. His physical appearance includes two sets of arms, glasses, and a mantle adorned with enchanted metal [[scales]]. Emotionally volatile, Porellus is prone to intense anger that causes his skin to turn a bright red. He maintains a deep resentment toward Vallenar, viewing him as an arrogant individual who lacks respect for the traditions of the Tower and should not have been permitted to train there. Despite his tendency toward hasty, aggressive actions—such as threatening others with wands or calling for security—he is also capable of attempting to navigate complex political situations involving the [[Galactic Union]] and corporate executives.}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-01-the-captain|This giant, beige, slug-like creature possesses a bulbous body characterized by pale skin and tendrils. Its physical form includes beetle eyes, tiny tentacles, many pseudo-legs, and two pairs of arms, including a lower set of hands. The [[Director]] also wears an ornate mantle resembling a scarf with metal [[scales]] sewn into the fabric.}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-01-the-captain|As a [[Director]] at the [[Magic Tower]], Porellus holds enough [[Authority|authority]] to suspend the narrator. The individual was once paid off to ensure that Tower security remained occupied.}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-01-the-captain|Porellus is an [[Archmage]] who utilizes wands. The character has also been known to roar for security.}}

== The Captain ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-01-the-captain|[[Director]] Porellus is an [[Archmage]] and [[Director]] at the [[Magic Tower]]. This pale, beige, slug-like creature possesses a bulbous body, beetle eyes, and many pseudo-legs alongside tiny tentacles and tendrils. The individual features two pairs of arms, including a lower pair of hands, and wears an ornate mantle resembling a scarf with sewn metal [[scales]]. During his tenure, Porellus used wands and roared for security, though he was ultimately paid off to keep the Tower's security occupied. Furthermore, he holds the [[Authority|authority]] to suspend the narrator.}}
